Nothin’ but a Good Time — Project 150’s 80s Rock Benefit

raw.description: Project 150 throws its annual benefit as a full 80s rock throwback at the INDUSTRIAL event space on South Industrial Road. Doors open at 6:30 p.m. and the party starts at 7:00 p.m. on Friday, October 16. Dress code is spandex, band tees, leather, neon and denim — best 80s rock band attire encouraged — and valet parking is available. Project 150 is a Las Vegas nonprofit supporting homeless, displaced and disadvantaged high school students across Southern Nevada, providing food, clothing, school supplies and scholarship support. The benefit is one of its larger annual fundraisers and pairs the party with a silent auction. Tickets are on sale now, with the organization asking guests to be on the list by October 10. Supporters who cannot attend can still bid in the silent auction online by texting PROJECT150 to 76278. Tickets and auction access are at Project150.givesmart.com.

The NAMB Annual Convention 2026, hosted by the National Association of Mortgage Brokers, takes place at Caesars Palace as a leading national event for mortgage professionals. Known as NAMB National, the convention gathers thousands of members, partners, exhibitors and sponsors, occupying an entire level of the resort’s conference tower. Mortgage brokers, loan originators, lenders and industry vendors attend to explore the latest products, technology and services, sharpen their skills through education, and build relationships across the mortgage profession. The program pairs a sold-out trade show floor with sessions and networking designed to help originators grow their businesses, stay compliant and navigate a changing lending environment. As the association advocating for mortgage brokers nationwide, NAMB positions the event as a premier destination for professionals seeking connection, continuing education and exposure to the partners that support their work. Held at one of the most iconic resorts on the Las Vegas Strip, NAMB National combines a major exhibition with robust learning and a lively atmosphere, making it a key annual gathering for the mortgage broker community.

Have you heard about the fastest growing industry specific networking groups at the Vegas Chamber? No!! Well, let me fill you in! And Friends is an industry specific networking group that allows those within the industry to connect and form power partnerships to grow their sphere of influence and business. The And Friends part is where we permit those who want to market or partner with the industry to join the group. This makes this series a powerhouse of networking possibilities. Paid Vegas Chamber Members in good standing will receive a copy of the Attendee List to help in fostering lasting business relationships. Non-Vegas Chamber members may attend as a one-time And Friends Guest by reaching out to Lita Stein via email: lstein@VegasChamber.com

The Recruiting Network holds a hiring event for entry-level, skilled and experienced job seekers. Attendees can meet recruiting teams about full-time and part-time positions. Admission is free for job seekers; employers and staffing organizations use a separate registration process. The listed event runs October 16 from 9:30 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. at the Marriott, 2989 Paradise Road. The organizer sends its employer list and location confirmation to registered attendees approximately 72 hours beforehand and notes that dates or locations can change. Job seekers should register and confirm those details before traveling.

BIOMED EXPO Las Vegas 2026 is scheduled for October 16–18 at Alexis Park Resort and is organized by BIOMED EXPO as part of the 5D Events series. The three-day program combines a public-facing health and wellness exposition with paid conference programming for professional and consumer audiences. Its stated subject areas include biohacking, biomedical technology, functional wellness, regenerative medicine, longevity, nutrition, energy-based wellness practices, consciousness, and selected space- and technology-related topics. The audience identified by the organizer includes physicians, dentists, chiropractors, scientists, researchers, naturopaths, herbalists, nutrition professionals, physical therapists, biomedical companies, technology suppliers, wellness practitioners, and consumers interested in the program’s themes. Event overview The organizer describes a program of lectures, workshops, panels, exhibits, professional networking, speaker meetings, and evening banquet functions. Exhibit categories include biomedical devices, wellness products, nutritional products, skincare, biohacking systems, and related services. Conference subjects range from stem-cell research, peptides, cellular therapy, biomolecular technologies, bioelectronics, and brain-health technologies to alternative-health practices, scalar-energy concepts, consciousness, and speculative science topics. These subjects represent the organizer’s published program; their inclusion in the event does not constitute an evaluation of medical efficacy or scientific consensus. BIOMED EXPO is structured as both a business-to-business and business-to-consumer event. The exhibit component provides space for manufacturers, practitioners, researchers, and service organizations to present products or discuss their work, while the conference program provides longer-form presentations and panels. The official ticket listing identifies the event as restricted to people age 18 and older. It also distinguishes free expo access from paid conference, streaming, and banquet products. Main public hours are listed as 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. across the published event dates, with registration opening before the program and separate dinner-and-dance banquets scheduled Friday and Saturday evenings. The technology content makes the event relevant to organizations working in biomedical products, digital and device-supported wellness, biotechnology, bioelectronics, diagnostics, research, and emerging health systems. At the same time, the agenda extends beyond conventional biomedical subjects into alternative medicine, personal-development, consciousness, and extraterrestrial or disclosure themes presented through the co-located Alien Event Cosmic Command program. Admission levels and room access may therefore differ by expo, conference, banquet, streaming, or co-located-event credential. The organizer’s current schedule and registration terms control final access and timing. History in Las Vegas The organizer characterizes the 2026 gathering as the fortieth event in the broader 5D Events series, which it dates to 2009. Available Las Vegas records document BIOMED EXPO at Alexis Park All Suite Resort in October 2024, and the organizer’s Eventbrite archive identifies another edition at Alexis Park in September 2025. Those records establish a recent pattern at the same Las Vegas property, although they do not demonstrate that every event in the overall series occurred in Las Vegas. The 2026 edition continues that verified local sequence at Alexis Park. Location Alexis Park Resort is located at 375 East Harmon Avenue in Las Vegas. The official property information describes an all-suite, non-gaming resort with meeting and banquet facilities, lodging, wireless internet in most public areas, and complimentary on-site parking. Its conference inventory includes the Apollo, Parthenon, and Zeus ballrooms along with smaller meeting rooms. That range of spaces can support the expo floor, simultaneous presentations, panels, registration, and banquet functions on one resort campus. Final ballroom assignments and access arrangements should be taken from the organizer’s event materials. BIOMED EXPO Las Vegas 2026 functions as a mixed professional and consumer gathering where biomedical, wellness, technology, alternative-health, and consciousness communities share exhibit and conference space under a single three-day program.

events.title: Molasky Family Department of Economics & Real Estate Seminar Series: Ed Coulson, UC-Irvine

raw.description: UNLV’s Molasky Family Department of Economics and Real Estate hosts a public research seminar with Ed Coulson. Coulson is a professor of economics and public policy at the University of California, Irvine and directs research at its Center for Real Estate. His research includes housing and rental markets, affordability, inflation and appraisals; he previously directed UNLV’s Lied Center for Real Estate. The seminar is free and open to the general public, and no registration is required. It takes place from 10:30 a.m. to noon in Hospitality Hall, Room 210, on UNLV’s Maryland Parkway campus. The department’s official event page provides contact information and any schedule updates.

raw.description: Join us for the 3rd annual Knowhere, No Boundaries a creative convergence hosted by AIA Northern Nevada, AIA Las Vegas and AIA Nevada. Made possible with the support of: Title Sponsor | CORE Construction and Nevada Sales, xyz, and AS VWB CS FG What happens when creators, visionaries, and masters of diverse mediums convene to explore a shared mission? Moving beyond the traditional framework of any single creative discipline, this event is a catalyst for unexpected cross-disciplinary connection and an interactive venue. Boundaries limit us, but “Knowhere” frees us. This is a space where a photographer’s lens influences a sculptor’s hands, and a dancer’s movement redefines an architect’s understanding of space. Six (6) Speakers representing various disciplines will share their unique process, inspiration, and their specific journey of bringing vision and creativity to the world. Step into an environment where creative boundaries do not exist and our shared passions are celebrated. Join us to challenge your perspective, engage in vibrant dialogue, and discover how our collective art disciplines shape and impact the human experience. Details to Know: Registration: $50 (includes catered lunch on Saturday) Speakers and presenters: To be announced Many attendees will be arriving Friday and staying two nights, with most lodging at the Mizpah Hotel (other options available in town) Optional activities include a haunted hotel tour, group dinner at the local brewery, and drinks at the hotel bar
